sentences.japanese: 君は、その２冊の本のうち、どちらを選んでもよい。
sentences.english: You may choose either of the two books.

sentences.japanese: 君がどんなにがんばっても、１日で５冊も小説を読むことはできないだろう。
sentences.english: Try as you may, you will not be able to read as many as five novels in a day.

sentences.japanese: 机の上には本が１冊しかない。
sentences.english: There is only one book on the desk.

sentences.japanese: 机の上に２冊しか本がなかった。
sentences.english: There were no more than two books on the desk.
